description.narrative: Breakthrough-ACTION will use state-of-the-art, evidence-based tools to encourage people in developing countries to adopt healthy behaviors, from using modern contraceptive methods to sleeping under bed nets to being tested for HIV. Much of the work will harness the power of communication - from mass media campaigns to TV and radio dramas to simple posters in a health clinic - to inspire long-lasting change. The project will also take advantage of other behavioral science approaches such as behavioral economics and human-centered design to improve programs. The program - which builds on a prior five-year, 31-country project called the Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) - is expected to be double the size. It will be led by CCP who will partner with Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya and Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION will also be supported in the field by ActionSprout, the International Center for Research on Women and Human Network International. CCP is based at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.

L'activité principale du programme de partenariat pour les services publics de l'énergie est l'établissement de partenariats exécutifs individuels entre les services publics d'électricité des pays en développement, les services publics de gaz, les opérateurs de transport et d'autres opérateurs et décideurs politiques du secteur énergétique et leurs homologues américains.

Breakthrough-ACTION utilisera des outils de pointe fondés sur des données probantes pour encourager les habitants des pays en développement à adopter des comportements sains, allant de l'utilisation de méthodes contraceptives modernes au sommeil sous des moustiquaires en passant par le dépistage du VIH. Une grande partie du travail exploitera le pouvoir de la communication – des campagnes médiatiques aux séries télévisées et radiophoniques en passant par les simples affiches dans une clinique de santé – pour inspirer un changement durable. Le projet tirera également parti d'autres approches des sciences du comportement, telles que l'économie comportementale et la conception centrée sur l'humain, pour améliorer les programmes. Le programme – qui s’appuie sur un projet antérieur de cinq ans portant sur 31 pays appelé Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) – devrait doubler de taille. Il sera dirigé par CCP qui s'associera à Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya et Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION sera également soutenu sur le terrain par ActionSprout, le Centre international de recherche sur les femmes et Human Network International. Le CCP est basé à la Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.

Breakthrough-ACTION utilizará herramientas de última generación basadas en evidencia para alentar a las personas de los países en desarrollo a adoptar comportamientos saludables, desde el uso de métodos anticonceptivos modernos hasta dormir bajo mosquiteros y hacerse la prueba del VIH. Gran parte del trabajo aprovechará el poder de la comunicación (desde campañas en los medios de comunicación hasta dramas de radio y televisión y simples carteles en una clínica de salud) para inspirar un cambio duradero. El proyecto también aprovechará otros enfoques de las ciencias del comportamiento, como la economía del comportamiento y el diseño centrado en el ser humano, para mejorar los programas. Se espera que el programa, que se basa en un proyecto anterior de cinco años de duración en 31 países llamado Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3), duplique su tamaño. Estará dirigido por CCP, que se asociará con Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya y Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION también contará con el apoyo en el campo de ActionSprout, el Centro Internacional de Investigación sobre Mujeres y Human Network International. CCP tiene su sede en la Escuela de Salud Pública Bloomberg de Johns Hopkins.

A Breakthrough-ACTION utilizará ferramentas de última geração baseadas em evidências para encorajar as pessoas nos países em desenvolvimento a adoptarem comportamentos saudáveis, desde a utilização de métodos contraceptivos modernos, passando por dormir debaixo de redes mosquiteiras até ao teste de VIH. Grande parte do trabalho aproveitará o poder da comunicação - desde campanhas nos meios de comunicação social, passando por dramas televisivos e radiofónicos, até simples cartazes numa clínica de saúde - para inspirar mudanças duradouras. O projeto também aproveitará outras abordagens da ciência comportamental, como a economia comportamental e o design centrado no ser humano, para melhorar os programas. Espera-se que o programa – que se baseia num projecto anterior de cinco anos e 31 países, denominado Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) – tenha o dobro da dimensão. Será liderado pelo CCP, que fará parceria com Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya e Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION também será apoiado no terreno pela ActionSprout, o Centro Internacional de Investigação sobre Mulheres e Rede Humana Internacional. O CCP está sediado na Escola de Saúde Pública Johns Hopkins Bloomberg.

Objectives for Nepal: 1. Assess and strengthen SBCC systems within the GON’s health system: Breakthrough ACTION Nepal works with the National Health Education Information Communication Center to analyze the current state of Nepal’s SBCC system. Using a participatory SBCC capacity mapping exercise at the federal and local levels, the activity will assess existing competencies, review guidelines and SBCC materials and design action plans to strengthen the SBCC system. It will also pilot a SBCC package in four municipalities. The lessons learned from this process will be shared to inform future SBCC capacity strengthening activities in the newly federalized health system. 2. Strengthen the GON’s use of high-quality data to inform program decisions at all levels. Breakthrough ACTION Nepal works with the National Health Education Information Communication Center to identify priority issues and analyze existing data from the government and partners to fill gaps in knowledge and inform SBCC activities for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health and nutrition. The activity will ensure that the data is user-friendly and easily accessible for critical decision-makers at appropriate levels. 3. Assess and strengthen coordination of the “SBCC system” among institutions, organizations and individuals practicing SBCC. Breakthrough ACTION Nepal will engage with SBCC stakeholders to refine and advance SBCC in Nepal. The activity will bring SBCC health partners and stakeholders together to map the relationships, responsibilities and resources in the newly federalized health system. This group will harmonize messages and approaches, strengthen SBCC coordination, and offer opportunities for participants to exchange lessons learned and advance high-quality SBCC programming through periodic ‘deep dives’ into key SBCC skills, such as audience segmentation, monitoring or new behavioral insights.

title.narrative: BREAKTHROUGH - Research
PERCÉE - Recherche
PERCÉE - Recherche

description.narrative: Breakthrough-RESEARCH will convene and engage a broad range of health and development stakeholders, supporting them in developing, promoting, and operationalizing visionary, consensus-driven agendas for Social and Behavior Change (SBC) research that contribute to measurable global health impact by providing the evidence needed to increase the practice of priority health behaviors and enable social norms for improved health and development outcomes. This may include, for example, synthesizing evidence and building consensus around SBC research agendas, designing and implementing high-priority SBC studies, and developing research utilization strategies and products tailored to end-users. Breakthrough-RESEARCH may also conduct performance and impact evaluations of SBC activities implemented through Mission bilateral or other central projects.

Breakthrough-ACTION utilisera des outils de pointe fondés sur des données probantes pour encourager les habitants des pays en développement à adopter des comportements sains, allant de l'utilisation de méthodes contraceptives modernes au sommeil sous des moustiquaires en passant par le dépistage du VIH. Une grande partie du travail exploitera le pouvoir de la communication – des campagnes médiatiques aux séries télévisées et radiophoniques en passant par les simples affiches dans une clinique de santé – pour inspirer un changement durable. Le projet tirera également parti d'autres approches des sciences du comportement, telles que l'économie comportementale et la conception centrée sur l'humain, pour améliorer les programmes. Le programme – qui s’appuie sur un projet antérieur de cinq ans portant sur 31 pays appelé Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) – devrait doubler de taille. Il sera dirigé par CCP qui s'associera à Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya et Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION sera également soutenu sur le terrain par ActionSprout, le Centre international de recherche sur les femmes et Human Network International. Le CCP est basé à la Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.

Breakthrough-RESEARCH réunira et engagera un large éventail d'acteurs de la santé et du développement, les aidant à développer, promouvoir et opérationnaliser des programmes visionnaires et consensuels pour la recherche sur le changement social et comportemental (SBC) qui contribuent à un impact mesurable sur la santé mondiale en fournissant les preuves nécessaires pour accroître la pratique des comportements de santé prioritaires et permettre l'établissement de normes sociales pour de meilleurs résultats en matière de santé et de développement. Cela peut inclure, par exemple, la synthèse des preuves et l'établissement d'un consensus autour des programmes de recherche SBC, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'études SBC hautement prioritaires et le développement de stratégies et de produits d'utilisation de la recherche adaptés aux utilisateurs finaux. Breakthrough-RESEARCH peut également mener des évaluations de performance et d'impact des activités SBC mises en œuvre dans le cadre de projets bilatéraux de mission ou d'autres projets centraux.

title.narrative: Seafood Alliance for Legality and Traceability (SALT)

description.narrative: The Seafood Alliance for Legality and Traceability (SALT) will mobilize constituencies, expertise, and other resources to promote legal, sustainable fisheries. The program will build international capacities to use data on the movement of seafood through the supply chain to promote better fisheries management and industry self-regulation. This public-private partnership enables efforts to prevent illegally harvested seafood from entering U.S. commerce, strengthening economic opportunities for legitimate fishers in the U.S. and globally. SALT will work to advance transparency in fisheries and seafood supply chains, advance traceability systems that help increase worker voice, and increase transparency around fishing crew movements to counter labor abuse on fishing vessels. SALT will assert U.S. leadership by promoting food and economic security, livelihoods, and biodiversity conservation.

title.narrative: CORE Group Polio Project
Projet CORE Group sur la polio
Projet CORE Group sur la polio

description.narrative: The CORE Group Polio Project (CGPP) began in Ethiopia in November 2001 and has addressed a variety of challenges by reaching hard-to-reach communities with vaccination services and surveillance. As a country at high risk for importation from neighboring conflict-affected Somalia and South Sudan, Ethiopia continues to maintain high immunization rates and excellent surveillance. The country has been free of wild polio virus since January 2014. CGPP-Ethiopia presently collaborates with six international NGOs (CARE Ethiopia, Catholic Relief Services, Save the Children, World Vision Ethiopia, International Rescue Committee and African Medical Research Foundation) and five local NGOs.

Breakthrough-RESEARCH réunira et engagera un large éventail d'acteurs de la santé et du développement, les aidant à développer, promouvoir et opérationnaliser des programmes visionnaires et consensuels pour la recherche sur le changement social et comportemental (SBC) qui contribuent à un impact mesurable sur la santé mondiale en fournissant les preuves nécessaires pour accroître la pratique des comportements de santé prioritaires et permettre l'établissement de normes sociales pour de meilleurs résultats en matière de santé et de développement. Cela peut inclure, par exemple, la synthèse des preuves et l'établissement d'un consensus autour des programmes de recherche SBC, la conception et la mise en œuvre d'études SBC hautement prioritaires et le développement de stratégies et de produits d'utilisation de la recherche adaptés aux utilisateurs finaux. Breakthrough-RESEARCH peut également mener des évaluations de performance et d'impact des activités SBC mises en œuvre dans le cadre de projets bilatéraux de mission ou d'autres projets centraux.

Le projet CORE Group Polio Project (CGPP) a débuté en Éthiopie en novembre 2001 et a relevé divers défis en atteignant les communautés difficiles d'accès avec des services de vaccination et de surveillance. En tant que pays à haut risque d’importation en provenance de la Somalie et du Soudan du Sud, pays voisins touchés par le conflit, l’Éthiopie continue de maintenir des taux de vaccination élevés et une excellente surveillance. Le pays est exempt de virus de la polio sauvage depuis janvier 2014. CGPP-Ethiopie collabore actuellement avec six ONG internationales (CARE Ethiopie, Catholic Relief Services, Save the Children, World Vision Ethiopie, International Rescue Committee et African Medical Research Foundation) et cinq ONG locales.

title.narrative: Building Healthy Cities (BHC)

description.narrative: The Building Healthy Cities (BHC) project aims to refocus city policies, planning, and services with a health equity lens while improving data-driven decision-making for "Smart Cities" in India, Indonesia, and Vietnam. The goal is to identify cost-efficient yet high impact ways to improve urban health across sectors; ensure health is appropriately accounted for within urban planning; reduce transaction costs of data produced for policy decisions; and empower citizens to demand better health-related services. The anticipated results of the project's work include changes to urban planning that improve access to health services, decrease risk factors for chronic diseases, lower the burden of infectious diseases, and widen access to data related to social determinants of health.

title.narrative: Partnership for Inclusive Agricultural Transformation in Africa (PIATA) Global Development Alliance
Parceria para a Transformação Agrícola Inclusiva em África (PIATA) Aliança para o Desenvolvimento Global

description.narrative: The Partnership for Inclusive Agricultural Transformation in Africa (PIATA) Global Development Alliance is a 5-year, partnership, between USAID, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF), the Rockefeller Foundation (RF), and the Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa (AGRA) that seeks to catalyze and sustain an inclusive agricultural transformation for 11 countries in Africa to increase incomes and improve the food security of 30 million smallholder farm households. The estimated duration of the activity is September 2017 - September 2022. The implementation instrument is a new cooperative agreement with mission buy-in capacity.

A Aliança para o Desenvolvimento Global da Parceria para a Transformação Agrícola Inclusiva em África (PIATA) é uma parceria de 5 anos entre a USAID, a Fundação Bill & Melinda Gates (BMGF), a Fundação Rockefeller (RF) e a Aliança para uma Revolução Verde em África (AGRA) que procura catalisar e sustentar uma transformação agrícola inclusiva em 11 países em África para aumentar os rendimentos e melhorar a segurança alimentar de 30 milhões de famílias agrícolas de pequenos agricultores. A duração estimada da atividade é de setembro de 2017 a setembro de 2022. O instrumento de implementação é um novo acordo de cooperação com capacidade de adesão à missão.

title.narrative: Ponya Mtoto (Scaling up PSBI Guidelines in Kenya)

description.narrative: This project aims to reduce young infant deaths from possible severe bacterial infections (PSBI). Through implementation research and revised national Integrated Management of Childhood Illness guidelines, the project will demonstrate and monitor the adaptation of PSBI guidelines in four counties of Kenya, incorporating an understanding of local microsystems through research and interaction at the service delivery level with patients, caregivers, community health volunteers/units, frontline health workers, health team managers, and referral mechanisms. The goal is successful and sustainable implementation of WHO PSBI guidelines and to influence policy change and systematic learning and adaptation.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Este programa apoya el objetivo de la Misión de lograr una Ucrania independiente, próspera y saludable, unida en torno a valores europeos fundamentales en uno o más de los siguientes sectores: fortalecimiento de la gobernanza democrática y un crecimiento económico más inclusivo, sostenible e impulsado por el mercado.

title.narrative: Capacity Building, Preparedness, and Planning

description.narrative: Improve the ability of the USG, host countries and other partners to prepare for and mitigate the effects of disasters, including both natural disasters and complex emergencies, taking into account the differences in men and womens freedom of movement and access to information. Activities under this component include any efforts to enhance the capacities of the USG (in Washington and in the field), humanitarian assistance providers, national host-country authorities, and local communities to engage in disaster reduction and response activities. Activities consist of standardized and coordinated assessments, monitoring, information sharing, data and situational analysis, joint planning; enhancement of coping mechanisms, including the capacity to address adaptation to constantly changing situations on the ground including climate variability and climate change.

title.narrative: Global Health Support Initiative II (GHSI II)

description.narrative: The Global Health Support Initiative improves the effectiveness of USAID population, health and nutrition programs. Using evidence-based best practices, the program's vision is to create a large, sustainable pool of talented global health professionals and responsive organizational and professional development programs. GHSI main areas of focus include: 1) the recruitment, placement, career development and mentoring of fellows and interns both in Washington DC and abroad; 2) implementation of a diversity initiative that creates opportunities for underrepresented populations in the field of global health; and 3) organizational development support for USAID staff in Washington, DC and USAID Missions and professional development opportunities for fellows and USAID staff.In Indonesia, the GHSI program supports three technical staff within the USAID/Indonesia health office - the Senior Infectious Disease and Science Advisor, the Senior Maternal Child Advisor, and the Global Fund Liaison.

Le projet CORE Group Polio Project (CGPP) a débuté en Éthiopie en novembre 2001 et a relevé divers défis en atteignant les communautés difficiles d'accès avec des services de vaccination et de surveillance. En tant que pays à haut risque d’importation en provenance de la Somalie et du Soudan du Sud, pays voisins touchés par le conflit, l’Éthiopie continue de maintenir des taux de vaccination élevés et une excellente surveillance. Le pays est exempt de virus de la polio sauvage depuis janvier 2014. CGPP-Ethiopie collabore actuellement avec six ONG internationales (CARE Ethiopie, Catholic Relief Services, Save the Children, World Vision Ethiopie, International Rescue Committee et African Medical Research Foundation) et cinq ONG locales.

La Global Health Support Initiative améliore l’efficacité des programmes de l’USAID en matière de population, de santé et de nutrition. En utilisant les meilleures pratiques fondées sur des données probantes, la vision du programme est de créer un bassin vaste et durable de professionnels de la santé mondiaux talentueux et des programmes de développement organisationnel et professionnel réactifs. Les principaux domaines d'intervention du GHSI comprennent : 1) le recrutement, le placement, le développement de carrière et le mentorat des boursiers et des stagiaires à Washington DC et à l'étranger ; 2) mise en œuvre d'une initiative de diversité qui crée des opportunités pour les populations sous-représentées dans le domaine de la santé mondiale ; et 3) un soutien au développement organisationnel pour le personnel de l'USAID à Washington, DC et dans les missions de l'USAID et des opportunités de développement professionnel pour les boursiers et le personnel de l'USAID. En Indonésie, le programme GHSI soutient trois membres du personnel technique au sein du bureau de santé de l'USAID/Indonésie - le conseiller principal en maladies infectieuses et scientifiques, le conseiller principal en matière de mère et d'enfant et l'agent de liaison du Fonds mondial.

La Global Health Support Initiative améliore l’efficacité des programmes de l’USAID en matière de population, de santé et de nutrition. En utilisant les meilleures pratiques fondées sur des données probantes, la vision du programme est de créer un bassin vaste et durable de professionnels de la santé mondiaux talentueux et des programmes de développement organisationnel et professionnel réactifs. Les principaux domaines d'intervention du GHSI comprennent : 1) le recrutement, le placement, le développement de carrière et le mentorat des boursiers et des stagiaires à Washington DC et à l'étranger ; 2) mise en œuvre d'une initiative de diversité qui crée des opportunités pour les populations sous-représentées dans le domaine de la santé mondiale ; et 3) un soutien au développement organisationnel pour le personnel de l'USAID à Washington, DC et dans les missions de l'USAID et des opportunités de développement professionnel pour les boursiers et le personnel de l'USAID. En Indonésie, le programme GHSI soutient trois membres du personnel technique au sein du bureau de santé de l'USAID/Indonésie - le conseiller principal en maladies infectieuses et scientifiques, le conseiller principal en matière de mère et d'enfant et l'agent de liaison du Fonds mondial.

La Iniciativa de Apoyo a la Salud Global mejora la eficacia de los programas de población, salud y nutrición de USAID. Utilizando las mejores prácticas basadas en evidencia, la visión del programa es crear un grupo grande y sostenible de talentosos profesionales de la salud global y programas receptivos de desarrollo organizacional y profesional. Las principales áreas de enfoque de GHSI incluyen: 1) el reclutamiento, colocación, desarrollo profesional y tutoría de becarios y pasantes tanto en Washington DC como en el extranjero; 2) implementación de una iniciativa de diversidad que cree oportunidades para poblaciones subrepresentadas en el campo de la salud global; y 3) apoyo al desarrollo organizacional para el personal de USAID en Washington, DC y las misiones de USAID y oportunidades de desarrollo profesional para becarios y personal de USAID. En Indonesia, el programa GHSI apoya a tres miembros del personal técnico dentro de la oficina de salud de USAID/Indonesia: el Asesor Principal de Ciencias y Enfermedades Infecciosas, el Asesor Principal Materno Infantil y el Enlace del Fondo Mundial.

Utilizando las mejores prácticas basadas en evidencia, la visión del programa es crear un grupo grande y sostenible de talentosos profesionales de la salud global y programas receptivos de desarrollo organizacional y profesional. A Iniciativa Global de Apoio à Saúde melhora a eficácia dos programas populacionais, de saúde e de nutrição da USAID. Utilizando as melhores práticas baseadas em evidências, a visão do programa é criar um conjunto grande e sustentável de profissionais de saúde globais talentosos e programas de desenvolvimento organizacional e profissional responsivos. As principais áreas de foco do GHSI incluem: 1) recrutamento, colocação, desenvolvimento de carreira e orientação de bolsistas e estagiários em Washington DC e no exterior; 2) implementação de uma iniciativa de diversidade que crie oportunidades para populações sub-representadas no campo da saúde global; e 3) apoio ao desenvolvimento organizacional para funcionários da USAID em Washington, DC e missões da USAID e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional para bolsistas e funcionários da USAID. Na Indonésia, o programa GHSI apoia três funcionários técnicos do escritório de saúde da USAID/Indonésia - o Conselheiro Sênior de Doenças Infecciosas e Ciência, o Conselheiro Sênior Materno Infantil e o Contato do Fundo Global.

title.narrative: African Strategies for Health (ASH)

description.narrative: African Stratiegies for Health (ASH) is a five-year project funded by the US Agency for International Development's (USAID) Bureau for Africa and implemented by Management Sciences for Health. ASH works to improve the health status of populations across Africa through identifying and advocating for best practices, enhancing technical capacity, and engaging Afican regional institutions to address health issues in a sustainable manner. ASH provides information on trends and developments on the continent to USAID and other development partners to enhance decision-making regarind investments in health.

title.narrative: Famine Early Warning System Network (FEWS NET) Technical Support

description.narrative: Kimetrica is developing and testing technological advances for USAIDs FEWS NET. These include web-based data capture, analysis, and visualization tools to help food security analysts better identify and report on famine threats and demographic analysis tools. One breakthrough product, (www.populationexplorer.com), has reduced the time it takes, from weeks to seconds, for analysts to estimate populations under threat. These advancements are literally changing the lives of thousands by improving the analysis of needs and increasing targeting efficiency. In addition to developing new technologies, Kimetricas Disaster Management Team is testing new methods for monitoring vulnerable populations in some of the worlds most challenging locations. Using Kimetricas remote information capture and transmission system, our analysts are helping USAID and others better understand local needs and determine the best response options.

title.narrative: Global Health Technical Assistance Bridge Project: GH Tech Bridge
Projet de pont d’assistance technique en santé mondiale : GH Tech Bridge
Proyecto Puente de Asistencia Técnica en Salud Global: GH Tech Bridge

description.narrative: The Project will also provide Global Health Bureau, Regional Bureaus, and USAID field missions with the ability to access independent specialists, including those from universities, not-for-profit, and for-profit organizations and to obtain technical services of key experts to support areas of strategic interest to USAID.

La Global Health Support Initiative améliore l’efficacité des programmes de l’USAID en matière de population, de santé et de nutrition. En utilisant les meilleures pratiques fondées sur des données probantes, la vision du programme est de créer un bassin vaste et durable de professionnels de la santé mondiaux talentueux et des programmes de développement organisationnel et professionnel réactifs. Les principaux domaines d'intervention du GHSI comprennent : 1) le recrutement, le placement, le développement de carrière et le mentorat des boursiers et des stagiaires à Washington DC et à l'étranger ; 2) mise en œuvre d'une initiative de diversité qui crée des opportunités pour les populations sous-représentées dans le domaine de la santé mondiale ; et 3) un soutien au développement organisationnel pour le personnel de l'USAID à Washington, DC et dans les missions de l'USAID et des opportunités de développement professionnel pour les boursiers et le personnel de l'USAID. En Indonésie, le programme GHSI soutient trois membres du personnel technique au sein du bureau de santé de l'USAID/Indonésie - le conseiller principal en maladies infectieuses et scientifiques, le conseiller principal en matière de mère et d'enfant et l'agent de liaison du Fonds mondial.

El Proyecto también brindará a la Oficina de Salud Global, las Oficinas Regionales y las misiones de campo de USAID la capacidad de acceder a especialistas independientes, incluidos aquellos de universidades y organizaciones sin fines de lucro y con fines de lucro, y de obtener servicios técnicos de expertos clave para apoyar áreas de interés estratégico para USAID.

title.narrative: Grant Management Solutions (GMS)
Soluciones de gestión de subvenciones (GMS)

description.narrative: Grant Management Solutions - Global Fund Technical Support (GFTS) 2.0: Provide technical support services to grantees worldwide that receive funding from the Global Fund to fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (Global Fund). MSH will provide short-term technical support services to Global Fund grantees and recipients for the purpose of resolving grant implementation bottlenecks and strengthening in-country stakeholders.

Soluciones de gestión de subvenciones - Soporte técnico del Fondo Mundial (GFTS) 2.0: Brinda servicios de soporte técnico a beneficiarios de todo el mundo que reciben financiamiento del Fondo Mundial para luchar contra el SIDA, la Tuberculosis y la Malaria (Fondo Mundial). MSH proporcionará servicios de apoyo técnico a corto plazo a los beneficiarios y beneficiarios del Fondo Mundial con el fin de resolver los obstáculos en la implementación de las subvenciones y fortalecer a las partes interesadas en los países.

Planification familiale et santé reproductive

description.narrative: Develop and conduct needs assessments, baseline studies, targeted evaluations, special studies or other information-gathering efforts specifically for the design, monitoring and evaluation of USG-funded programs. This sub-element may also include developing and disseminating best practices and lessons learned, testing demonstration and/or pilot models, or the preparation of strategic plans and other short-term programming tasks. Note: All such activities that are carried out by partners as an integral part of their monitoring and evaluation efforts for programs funded under other sub-elements should be included within those sub-elements.

Le contrat DHS-7 continuera d'être le principal mécanisme de mise en œuvre de l'USAID pour la collecte de données démographiques et sanitaires. Le but de ce contrat est d'améliorer la collecte, l'analyse et la présentation des données sur la population, la santé et la nutrition et de faciliter l'utilisation de ces données pour la planification, l'élaboration de politiques et la gestion de programmes.

Développer et mener des évaluations des besoins, des études de base, des évaluations ciblées, des études spéciales ou d'autres efforts de collecte d'informations spécifiquement pour la conception, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes financés par le gouvernement américain. Ce sous-élément peut également inclure l’élaboration et la diffusion des meilleures pratiques et des enseignements tirés, le test de modèles de démonstration et/ou pilotes, ou la préparation de plans stratégiques et d’autres tâches de programmation à court terme. Remarque : Toutes les activités menées par les partenaires dans le cadre de leurs efforts de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes financés au titre d'autres sous-éléments doivent être incluses dans ces sous-éléments.

Desarrollar y realizar evaluaciones de necesidades, estudios de referencia, evaluaciones específicas, estudios especiales u otros esfuerzos de recopilación de información específicamente para el diseño, seguimiento y evaluación de programas financiados por el Gobierno de los Estados Unidos. description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

Développer et mener des évaluations des besoins, des études de base, des évaluations ciblées, des études spéciales ou d'autres efforts de collecte d'informations spécifiquement pour la conception, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes financés par le gouvernement américain. Ce sous-élément peut également inclure l’élaboration et la diffusion des meilleures pratiques et des enseignements tirés, le test de modèles de démonstration et/ou pilotes, ou la préparation de plans stratégiques et d’autres tâches de programmation à court terme. Remarque : Toutes les activités menées par les partenaires dans le cadre de leurs efforts de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes financés au titre d'autres sous-éléments doivent être incluses dans ces sous-éléments.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

title.narrative: Professional Management Services Contract; Center for Development.Innovation
Contrato de Servicios de Gestión Profesional; Centro para el Desarrollo.Innovación

description.narrative: In support of its efforts to promote innovative programming within the agency, the Center for Development Innovation within the U.S. Global Development Lab awarded a Professional Management Consulting services contract to DAI in September 2014. Under this 4-year contract, DAI provided support to 24 Operating Units across the agency, including every center within the Lab and 19 USAID Missions around world. This work was done through 50 buy-ins, and focused on developing pipelines for new breakthroughs by harnessing the best in American and global innovation and entrepreneurship and engaging broad range of communities and stakeholders.

En apoyo de sus esfuerzos para promover una programación innovadora dentro de la agencia, el Centro para la Innovación en el Desarrollo dentro del Laboratorio de Desarrollo Global de EE. UU. otorgó un contrato de servicios de consultoría de gestión profesional a DAI en septiembre de 2014. En virtud de este contrato de 4 años, DAI brindó apoyo a 24 unidades operativas en toda la agencia, incluidos todos los centros dentro del laboratorio y 19 misiones de USAID en todo el mundo. Este trabajo se realizó a través de 50 participaciones y se centró en desarrollar canales para nuevos avances aprovechando lo mejor de la innovación y el emprendimiento estadounidenses y globales e involucrando a una amplia gama de comunidades y partes interesadas.

description.narrative: This contract will serve as the primary vehicle through which USAID will assure the quality of health commodities procured in support of global health programs. FHI 360 will perform the following activities to ensure high quality health commodities: Establish a comprehensive quality assurance program; Design and implement a quality control strategy; Provide technical leadership in forums within the quality assurance arena; Provide technical assistance to partner country medicines regulatory authority, other government bodies, and academic institutions; and, Collaborate with global partners (e.g., Global Fund, UNFPA) and other contractors within the Global Health Supply Chain Program.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

Ce contrat servira de principal véhicule par lequel l'USAID garantira la qualité des produits de santé achetés pour soutenir les programmes de santé mondiaux. FHI 360 réalisera les activités suivantes pour garantir des produits de santé de haute qualité : Établir un programme complet d'assurance qualité ; Concevoir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de contrôle qualité ; Assurer un leadership technique dans les forums du domaine de l'assurance qualité ; Fournir une assistance technique à l'autorité de réglementation des médicaments du pays partenaire, à d'autres organismes gouvernementaux et aux établissements universitaires ; et Collaborer avec des partenaires mondiaux (par exemple, le Fonds mondial, le FNUAP) et d'autres sous-traitants au sein du programme de chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale en santé.

Este contrato servirá como el vehículo principal a través del cual USAID garantizará la calidad de los productos sanitarios adquiridos en apoyo de los programas de salud globales. FHI 360 realizará las siguientes actividades para garantizar productos de salud de alta calidad: Establecer un programa integral de garantía de calidad; Diseñar e implementar una estrategia de control de calidad; Proporcionar liderazgo técnico en foros dentro del ámbito del aseguramiento de la calidad; Proporcionar asistencia técnica a la autoridad reguladora de medicamentos del país socio, otros organismos gubernamentales e instituciones académicas; y, Colaborar con socios globales (por ejemplo, Fondo Mundial, UNFPA) y otros contratistas dentro del Programa Mundial de la Cadena de Suministro de Salud.

Este contrato servirá como o principal veículo através do qual a USAID garantirá a qualidade dos produtos de saúde adquiridos em apoio aos programas de saúde globais. A FHI 360 realizará as seguintes actividades para garantir produtos de saúde de alta qualidade: Estabelecer um programa abrangente de garantia de qualidade; Desenhar e implementar uma estratégia de controlo de qualidade; Fornecer liderança técnica em fóruns na área de garantia de qualidade; Fornecer assistência técnica à autoridade reguladora de medicamentos do país parceiro, a outros órgãos governamentais e a instituições académicas; e, Colaborar com parceiros globais (por exemplo, Fundo Global, UNFPA) e outros contratados dentro do Programa Global de Cadeia de Fornecimento de Saúde.

title.narrative: Securing Water for Food (SWFF) Technical Assistance Facility,

description.narrative: Securing Water for Food: A Grand Challenge for Development (SWFF) through its Technical Assistance Facility, a project of The Kaizen Company, provides financial and acceleration support to the game-changing innovators who work at the nexus of water and agriculture. This hybrid incubator-accelerator helps innovators improve their market-driven business development, commercial growth, and scaling. The SWFF TA Facility consults and works hand-in-hand with each Grand Challenge innovator to identify their specific barriers to hitting targets and scaling their technologies, and then connects them high-impact service providers that bring the capabilities, global presence, and specific country knowledge to help them overcome those barriers. The TA Facility also works with partners along the food value chain to test and market innovations, and to provide needs-based and tailored services to help the innovators address one of the worlds most pressing development challenges.

title.narrative: Middle East Bureau Support

description.narrative: The purpose of the Middle East Bureau Support contract is to provide analytical support and technical assistance services to USAID's Middle East (ME) Bureau. The Contractor shall provide technical and other specialists to meet short to medium-term requirements that allow USAID to respond to evolving programs of national priority and address key Administration goals. Specialists shall provide technical assistance related to program design, program management, program monitoring, outreach and information development, and associated administrative support activities.

title.narrative: Administrative, Technical, and Support Staff Services to the Bureaus of Asia and Legislative and Public Affairs
Serviços de pessoal administrativo, técnico e de apoio aos Bureaus da Ásia e Assuntos Legislativos e Públicos.

description.narrative: The contrator shall provide administrative, technical, and support staff services to the bureaus of Asia and Legislative and Public Affairs. This contract is to provide a core staff of employees and a workforce surge capacity of support services including administrative, technical, and support staff needed for program design, implementation, oversight, monitoring, and evaluation to the Asia and Legislative and Public Affairs (LPA) Bureau's for The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) located in Washington, D.C., with possible work sites overseas in the Asia region.

O contratante fornecerá serviços administrativos, técnicos e de pessoal de apoio aos escritórios da Ásia e de Assuntos Legislativos e Públicos. Este contrato visa fornecer uma equipe principal de funcionários e uma capacidade de aumento de força de trabalho de serviços de apoio, incluindo pessoal administrativo, técnico e de apoio necessário para a concepção, implementação, supervisão, monitoramento e avaliação do programa para o Bureau da Ásia e de Assuntos Legislativos e Públicos (LPA) para a Agência dos Estados Unidos para o Desenvolvimento Internacional (USAID) localizado em Washington, D.C., com possíveis locais de trabalho no exterior, na região da Ásia.

description.narrative: USAID seeks institutional support services for AFR staffing, both in Washington, DC and in Africa. The technical and support services provided under this contract will assist USAID in achieving its program priorities by providing contracted technical, professional, operational, and administrative support staff in support of USAIDs African programs on both a short- and long-term basis.

Fournir des biens, du personnel, des services et une assistance pour répondre aux besoins humains fondamentaux afin de favoriser la transition après les secours selon les principes d'universalité, d'impartialité et de dignité humaine. Cet élément doit être réalisé, lorsque cela est possible, dans le cadre d'une approche intégrée, coordonnée et/ou multisectorielle.

L'USAID recherche des services de soutien institutionnel pour le personnel de l'AFR, à la fois à Washington, DC et en Afrique. Les services techniques et de soutien fournis dans le cadre de ce contrat aideront l'USAID à atteindre ses priorités de programme en fournissant du personnel de soutien technique, professionnel, opérationnel et administratif sous contrat pour soutenir les programmes africains de l'USAID à court et à long terme.

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to 1) Provide technical assistance (TA) to PEPFAR IPs, U.S. Government (USG) and USAID field teams to complete the EA reporting requirements mandated by S/GAC and ensure high data quality; 2) Develop necessary budgeting and planning tools for USG teams to apply EA data for country/regional operational plan (COP/ROP) budgeting and programming; and 3) Support capacity-building and analytical activities to strengthen use of EA and related data for program planning and budgeting.

P-Advisory- Promoción de la excelencia en la participación del sector privado (PEPSE)

description.narrative: Promoting Excellence in Private Sector Engagement (PEPSE): The purpose of this activity is to advance Agency-wide efforts in effective private sector engagement and to provide technical assistance related to building public-private partnerships. This activity will enable the Lab to continue to build partnerships with the private sector, leverage resources to expand the impact of foreign assistance budgets, and also bring the unique expertise and assets of the private sector to make our work more efficient and effective. This award supports implementation of the Lab's Private Sector Engagement training; provides technical assistance to MBIOs on building partnerships and gaining a better understanding of opportunity for partnership in a given country or sector; and,supports data collection and management (for the Agency) related to public private partnerships.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

Promouvoir l'excellence dans l'engagement du secteur privé (PEPSE) : Le but de cette activité est de faire progresser les efforts à l'échelle de l'Agence en matière d'engagement efficace du secteur privé et de fournir une assistance technique liée à la création de partenariats public-privé. Cette activité permettra au Laboratoire de continuer à établir des partenariats avec le secteur privé, à mobiliser des ressources pour accroître l'impact des budgets d'aide étrangère, et également à apporter l'expertise et les atouts uniques du secteur privé pour rendre notre travail plus efficient et efficace. Ce prix soutient la mise en œuvre de la formation sur l'engagement du secteur privé du Laboratoire ; fournit une assistance technique aux MBIO pour établir des partenariats et acquérir une meilleure compréhension des opportunités de partenariat dans un pays ou un secteur donné ; et, soutient la collecte et la gestion des données (pour l'Agence) liées aux partenariats public-privé.

Promouvoir l'excellence dans l'engagement du secteur privé (PEPSE) : Le but de cette activité est de faire progresser les efforts à l'échelle de l'Agence en matière d'engagement efficace du secteur privé et de fournir une assistance technique liée à la création de partenariats public-privé. Cette activité permettra au Laboratoire de continuer à établir des partenariats avec le secteur privé, à mobiliser des ressources pour accroître l'impact des budgets d'aide étrangère, et également à apporter l'expertise et les atouts uniques du secteur privé pour rendre notre travail plus efficient et efficace. Ce prix soutient la mise en œuvre de la formation sur l'engagement du secteur privé du Laboratoire ; fournit une assistance technique aux MBIO pour établir des partenariats et acquérir une meilleure compréhension des opportunités de partenariat dans un pays ou un secteur donné ; et, soutient la collecte et la gestion des données (pour l'Agence) liées aux partenariats public-privé.

Promoción de la excelencia en la participación del sector privado (PEPSE): El propósito de esta actividad es promover los esfuerzos de toda la Agencia en la participación efectiva del sector privado y brindar asistencia técnica relacionada con la creación de asociaciones público-privadas. Esta actividad permitirá al Laboratorio continuar construyendo asociaciones con el sector privado, aprovechar recursos para ampliar el impacto de los presupuestos de asistencia extranjera y también aportar la experiencia y los activos únicos del sector privado para hacer nuestro trabajo más eficiente y efectivo. Este premio respalda la implementación de la capacitación sobre participación del sector privado del laboratorio; brinda asistencia técnica a las MBIO para crear asociaciones y obtener una mejor comprensión de las oportunidades de asociación en un país o sector determinado; y apoya la recopilación y gestión de datos (para la Agencia) relacionados con asociaciones público-privadas.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

title.narrative: Private Sector Productivity

description.narrative: Improve the capacity of businesses to integrate into domestic and international markets through increases in productivity and improvements in corporate governance and the development and application of modern technology and marketing practices. Enhance the capacity of businesses and business associations in terms of their corporate governance capabilities and their application of best practices and technologies to achieve increased production and marketing of products and services. It includes adoption of efficient production processes, improved labor productivity, environmentally-sound management of natural resources and the development of accounting and management systems that can help the company and industry group implement business, labor, product and process standards that enhance business competitiveness. Business capacity development programs may include activities that help men- and women-owned firms and associations respond to these international markets and create regional alliances.

title.narrative: Project Cure

description.narrative: WHO identified the shortage of functional medical equipment in low-income countries as a critical barrier to meeting the health-related Millennium Development Goals (MDGs). The public-private partnership with Project C.U.R.E. will increase USAID's contribution to health systems strengthening (HSS) in DRC through the provision of quality and customized medical equipment and supplies to healthcare facilities in USAID supported health zones, supporting all sectors of the health program, including TB and FP. Project C.U.R.E. will obtain donations of equipment from medical manufacturers, wholesale suppliers, and hospitals in the United States and will plan the shipments according to the priority needs of the country. Project C.U.R.E. will be compliant with the WHO Guidelines for Equipment Donations and relevant US government policies. USAID anticipates that this investment will contribute to improved quality of care and increased demand for services in USAID supported facilities.

title.narrative: Performance Monitoring and Evaluation Training
Capacitación en seguimiento y evaluación del desempeño

description.narrative: In order to strengthen USAID's internal capacity to conduct high quality evaluation and performance monitoring - including the development of strong result frameworks, high quality, outcome oriented indicators, and comprehensive performance management plans - PPL will provide technical assistance to develop and deliver performance monitoring (PM) and evaluation (E) training courses and related capacity building products for USAID staff in Washington, the Missions, and implementing partners (IPs) globally. Training courses will build the capacity of USAID staff to plan, manage, and use PM&E to inform USAID strategies and project design and foster Agency learning. Web-based support modules will be included.

Con el fin de fortalecer la capacidad interna de USAID para realizar evaluaciones de alta calidad y monitoreo del desempeño, incluido el desarrollo de marcos de resultados sólidos, indicadores de alta calidad orientados a resultados y planes integrales de gestión del desempeño, PPL brindará asistencia técnica para desarrollar e impartir cursos de capacitación en monitoreo del desempeño (PM) y evaluación (E) y productos relacionados de desarrollo de capacidades para el personal de USAID en Washington, las Misiones y los socios implementadores (IP) a nivel mundial. Los cursos de capacitación desarrollarán la capacidad del personal de USAID para planificar, gestionar y utilizar el SyEP para informar las estrategias de USAID y el diseño de proyectos y fomentar el aprendizaje de la Agencia. Se incluirán módulos de soporte basados ​​en web.

title.narrative: Plan of the Alliance for Prosperity in the Northern Triangle: A Road Map
Reformas anticorrupción
Reformas anticorrupción
Reformas anticorrupción

description.narrative: Support program for strategic actions of the plan of the alliance for the prosperity of the northern triangle. The countries of the Northern Triangle, have agreed on the guidelines of a plan of the Alliance for the prosperity of the Northern Triangle that will direct the priority measures that we will undertake over the medium term to create development conditions that will allow people to keep living in our countries.The strategic actions of the Plan aim to: A. Stimulate the productive sector to create economic opportunities B. Develop opportunities for our people C. Improve public safety and enhancing access to the legal system D. Strengthen institutions to increase peoples trust in the State Stronger growth in our economies requires attracting private investment, promoting certain sectors with development potential and concentrating activities in strategic geographical areas. This will be possible only if at the same time we undertake measures and carry out projects to reduce energy costs, make essential investments to improve infrastructure and logistics, and facilitate trade in a more integrated fashion. Also, these investments and measures must be.concentrated in areas and regions that can become future centers that drive development. Our peoples investment opportunities and improving their quality of life will be achieved only if their skills are fully developed. Labor supply and demand from businesses must be more tightly linked. We also need more effective vocational training, greater access to and better qualitysecondary education, and more investment in children, the human capital of the future.Improving public safety and access to justice are essential for our people to live together inpeace and for promoting private investment. We need to do more to prevent violence, makeschools safe, and protect at-risk youths. We must also strengthen government institutions andthe justice system so as to attack the roots of the problems of violence and lack of s

title.narrative: Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Collaborative Research on Adapting Livestock Systems to Climate Change

description.narrative: The Colorado State University Livestock-Climate Change CRSP aims to reduce vulnerability, increase adaptive capacity, and augment the income of livestock producers in regions where agricultural systems are changing, available resources are shrinking, and climate is having an impact. Colorado State University received a five-year, $15 million Leader-with-Associate Award from the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) in 2010 to manage the Collaborative Research Support Program, Adapting Livestock Systems to Climate Change (Livestock-Climate Change CRSP). In 2013, USAID mandated a name change from CRSP to Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Collaborative Research on Adapting Livestock Systems to Climate Change.

title.narrative: Global Labor Program (Follow-on)

description.narrative: Under the second Global Labor Program: Promoting International Labor Standards, Improving Workers Access to Justice and Supporting Independent, Democratic Labor Unions and NGOs Program (Global Labor Program) the Solidarity Center provides technical assistance to 1) promote the adoption and effective enforcement of core labor standards; 2) establish legal frameworks to protect and promote civil society; 3) increase citizen participation in policy processes, implementation, and oversight of public institutions; 4) increase institutional and financial viability of labor unions and labor NGOs; 5) enhance free flow of information; 6) strengthen democratic culture and gender equity; 7) support anti-sweatshop activities; 8) promote broad-based, equitable economic growth; 9) build human capacity through education and training; and 10) improve health through workplace and peer-to-peer health education and prevention. The centers work is based on three fundamental issues: adherence to core labor standards, gender integration, and the use of partnerships and communications technology to promote coalitions across civil society and national borders.

title.narrative: Farmer-to-Farmer for Agriculture Education and Training (FtF)

description.narrative: Farmer-to-Farmer for Agriculture Education and Training (FtF) - The John Ogonowski and Doug Bereuter Farmer-to-Farmer Program (F2F) provides technical assistance from U.S. volunteers to farmers, farm groups, agribusinesses and other agriculture sector institutions in developing and transitional countries with the goal of promoting sustainable improvements in food security and agricultural processing, production and marketing. The F2F program leverages the expertise of volunteers from U.S. farms, universities, cooperatives, private agribusinesses and nonprofit farm organizations to respond to the local needs of host-country farmers and organizations. Volunteers, recruited from all 50 states and the District of Columbia, are generally individuals who have domestic careers, farms and agribusinesses, or are retirees who want to participate in development efforts; volunteers do not have to be overseas development professionals to join the program. Volunteers tend to be senior or mid-career professionals with practical agro-industry experience.

description.narrative: This program supports the Mission's goal for an independent, prosperous, and healthy Ukraine united around core European values in one or more of the following sectors: strengthening of democratic governance, and more inclusive, sustainable, market-driven economic growth.

La mission du laboratoire d'innovation Feed the Future pour la politique de sécurité alimentaire (FSP) est d'aider les pays soutenus par l'USAID en Afrique, en Asie et en Amérique latine à lutter contre la faim, à réduire la pauvreté et à améliorer les résultats nutritionnels grâce à une meilleure politique alimentaire.

Ce programme soutient l'objectif de la mission d'une Ukraine indépendante, prospère et saine, unie autour des valeurs européennes fondamentales dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : le renforcement de la gouvernance démocratique et une croissance économique plus inclusive, durable et axée sur le marché.

title.narrative: Developing Local Extension Capacity (DLEC)
Développement des capacités de vulgarisation locale (DLEC)
Développement des capacités de vulgarisation locale (DLEC)

description.narrative: DLEC project is a network of the world's foremost extension experts providing technical and strategic support to missions and country systems to improve smallholder farmers' livelihoods. DLEC uses a best-fit framework to guide analyses and to determine areas of focus for activities. The best-fit framework allows users to analyze a country's system,begin conversations with local stakeholders to understand state of their system and critical levers for change might be and analyze& recommend systems change. The LWA is designed to diagnose, pilot & share locally-customized, best-fit solutions for extension systems & advisory services.

Le laboratoire d'innovation des systèmes d'élevage vise à réaliser des améliorations mesurables et durables dans la production et la sécurité des aliments d'origine animale ainsi que dans les revenus et la nutrition des éleveurs grâce à des technologies, un renforcement des capacités et des politiques améliorés et appropriés.

Le projet DLEC est un réseau des plus grands experts mondiaux en vulgarisation fournissant un soutien technique et stratégique aux missions et aux systèmes nationaux pour améliorer les moyens de subsistance des petits exploitants agricoles. DLEC utilise un cadre le mieux adapté pour guider les analyses et déterminer les domaines d’intervention des activités. Le cadre le mieux adapté permet aux utilisateurs d'analyser le système d'un pays, d'entamer des conversations avec les parties prenantes locales pour comprendre l'état de leur système et les leviers critiques du changement qui pourraient être, et d'analyser et de recommander des changements dans les systèmes. Le LWA est conçu pour diagnostiquer, piloter et partager les solutions les mieux adaptées et personnalisées au niveau local pour les systèmes de vulgarisation et les services de conseil.

title.narrative: Multi-Country Strengthening Pharmaceutical Systems Associate Award
Prêmio Associado de Fortalecimento de Sistemas Farmacêuticos de Vários Países.

description.narrative: SPS works in more than 20 developing and transitional countries to provide technical assistance to strengthen pharmaceutical and health commodity management systems. The program offers technical guidance and assists in strategy development and program implementation both in improving the availability of health commodities - pharmaceuticals, vaccines, supplies, and basic medical equipment - of assured quality for maternal and child health, HIV/AIDS, infectious diseases, and family planning and in promoting the appropriate use of health commodities in the public and private sectors.

A SPS trabalha em mais de 20 países em desenvolvimento e em transição para fornecer assistência técnica para fortalecer os sistemas de gestão de produtos farmacêuticos e de saúde. O programa oferece orientação técnica e ajuda no desenvolvimento de estratégias e na implementação de programas, tanto na melhoria da disponibilidade de produtos de saúde - produtos farmacêuticos, vacinas, suprimentos e equipamento médico básico - de qualidade garantida para a saúde materna e infantil, VIH/SIDA, doenças infecciosas e planeamento familiar, como na promoção do uso apropriado de produtos de saúde nos sectores público e privado.

title.narrative: Civic Participation

description.narrative: Strengthen the legal, regulatory, institutional, and information environment which protects and enables the growth in associational life and the development of independent and sustainable civil society organizations (CSOs). Build the capacity of civil society organizations to act as agents for reform and support their participation in democratic decision-making through articulating and representing their members interests, engaging in service delivery, and advocating for issues which become part of the public agenda and are reflected in public policies. Encourage the strengthening of a civic culture which supports democratic institutions and processes, active participation in political and civic life, and the civic virtues of tolerance, pluralism, compromise, trust, and respect for individual rights, including gender equality.

title.narrative: HED Partnership: Initiative for Conservation in the Andean Amazon (ICAA) Higher Education Partnership Program

description.narrative: The ICAA Higher Education Partnership Program seeks to further engage and strengthen the capacity of regional universities in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru to promote biodiversity conservation and maintenance of the Andean Amazon Biome. HED and its implementing university partners are working in close collaboration with existing ICAA support units and USAID to address country-specific challenges and work towards the following objectives: 1) To strengthen the institutional capacities of local universities in the Andean Amazon region to provide high-quality degree and/or certificate training in fields relevant to biodiversity conservation and resource management; 2) To enhance the ability of local universities and organizations in the Andean Amazon region to conduct and disseminate applied research in fields relevant to biodiversity conservation and resource management; and 3) To strengthen the ability of local universities and organizations in the Andean Amazon region towork collaboratively and across the region to address key environmental issues and contribute solutions to these issues.

title.narrative: Information Safety and Capacity Project (ISC)

description.narrative: ISC Project, a USAID project that provides information security and capacity building assistance to civil society organizations, human rights activists, and independent media in countries where a restrictive environment for information and internet use impinges on freedom of expression, advocacy, journalism, and online communications that are necessary for the development of a vibrant civil society and poses risks to both civil society organizations (CSOs) and individuals. The ISC Project providesmentoring and support services to assist local partners with securing their online and mobile communications, websites, information technology (IT) systems, and data to prevent attacks on and unauthorized access to these systems and data that could compromise confidential information or put CSOs or individuals at risk.

title.narrative: Libya Elections and Governance Support (LEGS) project

description.narrative: The goal of this program is to strengthen citizen confidence in Libyas elected government during a key political transition in the country.

Objectives for Libya: To provide assistance to Libyan government institutions and civil society organizations as they attempt to navigate the country’s transition from an authoritarian regime to a democratic system. NDI is providing assistance to newly created grassroots and civil society organizations (CSOs) that encourage broad public participation in the political process and elected institutions with the goal of increasing citizen engagement. NDI works with historically marginalized groups, including women, young people and ethnic minorities who are organizing to increase representation in Libyan politics.

title.narrative: Accelerating Strategies for Practical Innovation and Research in Economic Strengthening (ASPIRES) project
Projeto Acelerando Estratégias para Inovação Prática e Pesquisa em Fortalecimento Econômico (ASPIRES).

description.narrative: The Accelerating Strategies for Practical Innovation and Research in Economic Strengthening (ASPIRES) project is managed by FHI 360, a non-profit human development organization. ASPIRES supports evidence-based, gender-sensitive programming to improve the economic security and well-being outcomes of vulnerable families and children, particularly those infected with or affected by HIV/AIDS, and others at high risk of acquiring HIV. ASPIRES is funded by the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) and the Presidents Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief (PEPFAR),

O projecto Estratégias de Aceleração para Inovação Prática e Investigação no Fortalecimento Económico (ASPIRES) é gerido pela FHI 360, uma organização de desenvolvimento humano sem fins lucrativos. A ASPIRES apoia uma programação baseada em evidências e sensível ao género para melhorar a segurança económica e os resultados de bem-estar de famílias e crianças vulneráveis, particularmente aquelas infectadas ou afectadas pelo VIH/SIDA, e outras pessoas em alto risco de contrair o VIH. ASPIRES é financiado pela Agência dos Estados Unidos para o Desenvolvimento Internacional (USAID) e pelo Plano de Emergência do Presidente para o Alívio da SIDA (PEPFAR).

title.narrative: Workforce Connections

description.narrative: Workforce Connections' works with E3/Education in its learning, outreach, and technical leadership to advance the achievement of its Education Strategy-Goal 2: 'an improved ability of tertiary and workforce development programs to produce a workforce with relevant skills to support country development goals by 2015'. Specifically, E3/Education seeks to support or establish an evidence-based and cost-effective workforce development model supported by meaningful results confirming work readiness and job placement. This model, and associated progress achievements, will be communicated to and coordinated with a dedicated group of internal and external workforce development stakeholders, including E3/Education Officers, the private sector, key Non-government organizations, and partner governments.

title.narrative: Anti-Corruption Reforms

description.narrative: Promote governance institutions, processes, and policies that are transparent and accountable across all development sectors. Support non-governmental as well as governmental institutions (including enforcement and investigation entities, independent audit agencies, anti-corruption commissions, procurement agencies, legislatures, line ministries, independent agencies, political parties, judicial actors, as well as civil society organizations, academia, press and the private sector). Support civic education and advocacy for reform of laws and practices or directly improving accountability and transparency of governance processes covering various development sectors.

title.narrative: Promoting Inclusive Democratic Governance (PRIDE) II

description.narrative: The Promoting Inclusive and Democratic Engagement II activity engages Syrians in local political processes and increases political and civic participation and representation of women, youth and minorities. Major activities include workshops and trainings, developing community needs assessments, and carrying out advocacy campaigns. When Syrian democratic actors - especially women, youth, and minorities -- are empowered to play an active role in governance and peacebuilding, citizens' needs will be better served, opposition credibility will be bolstered, pressure for a negotiated political settlement will increase, and extremism will be effectively countered. The goal of this program is to support and create demand for the establishment of robust, inclusive, effective, and accountable democratic processes and institutions in Syria, to advance freedom, dignity, and development.

title.narrative: Feed the Future African Great Lakes Region Coffee Support Program

description.narrative: The Potato Taste Defect on Coffee activity is a Washington-based Associate Award under a Leader with Associates Award to control potato taste defect in coffee and improve coffee productivity in the Great Lakes region. It will be co-funded by USAID/Washington, USAID/Burundi and USAID/Rwanda.~This activity will include research and dissemination of best practices, capacity building among coffee farmers, and policy formulation.

title.narrative: ME Regional Support to Democratic Transition

description.narrative: Through regional mechanisms, USAID will provide missions and USAID/Washington with the tools and capacity to quickly respond to ongoing transitions with planning and programs in areas related to political transitions and the fluid security environment. Efforts would include facilitating the sharing of best practices and innovations among civil society across the region, and countering violent extremism and conflict mitigation. Mechanisms will enable USAID to draw upon regional expertise to tailor programming to region-specific dynamics and will seek to develop regional capacity. Programming will promote transparent and participatory democratic processes, counter violent extremist threats in a targeted manner, and address broad conflict mitigation and reconciliation needs. Every effort will be made to seek local partners who can participate in implementation.

title.narrative: Civic Participation

description.narrative: Strengthen the legal, regulatory, institutional, and information environment which protects and enables the growth in associational life and the development of independent and sustainable civil society organizations (CSOs). Build the capacity of civil society organizations to act as agents for reform and support their participation in democratic decision-making through articulating and representing their members interests, engaging in service delivery, and advocating for issues which become part of the public agenda and are reflected in public policies. Encourage the strengthening of a civic culture which supports democratic institutions and processes, active participation in political and civic life, and the civic virtues of tolerance, pluralism, compromise, trust, and respect for individual rights, including gender equality.

title.narrative: National Assembly

description.narrative: USAID is building the capacity of the democratically elected National Assembly (NA) to function effectively as a legislature and to raise awareness to its constituents regarding the work that a NA should be performing but unable to under the current restricted environment imposed by President Maduro, the judicial branch, and the newly created Constituent Assembly. The latter was created in an arbitrary and unconstitutional manner by President Maduro in order to draft a new constitution that will likely consolidate PSUV's (ruling party) power. Consequently, USAID support to the NA will now focus on building communication capacity, constituent relations and elaboration of policy positions for sectors such as health, education, economic recovery and citizen security.
